extractList.title: Extract Links / Emails
extractList.description: Extract one item per line, preserving order and duplicates by default. Markdown uses destinations, not labels or titles. Preview before copying; no links or images are opened.
param.extractList.kindHint: Links need http:// or https://. Common emails: name+tag@example.com. Separate addresses from surrounding words with spaces or punctuation; quoted and international addresses are unsupported.
param.extractList.dedupHint: Off by default. Enable to keep only the first occurrence. Links match exactly; email domains ignore case while the part before @ is case-sensitive.
extractList.noUrls: No HTTP(S) links found. Add text containing http:// or https:// links, or choose email addresses.
extractList.noEmails: No supported email addresses found. Add text containing an address such as name+tag@example.com, or choose HTTP(S) links.
extractList.invalidKind: Choose HTTP(S) links or common email addresses and try again.
cleanList.title: Clean Line List
cleanList.description: Trim edges → remove blank lines → remove duplicates. By default, only blank lines are removed; spacing and duplicates stay. Keeps the original line order.
param.cleanList.trimHint: Off by default. Removes spaces, tabs, and other whitespace at each line’s edges; preserves the content between them.
param.cleanList.removeBlankHint: On by default. Removes empty or whitespace-only lines, even when trimming is off. All options off leaves the input unchanged.
param.cleanList.dedupHint: Off by default. Compares exact text after the previous steps, case-sensitively. Keeps the first occurrence without sorting.

cleanAgent.title: Clean Agent Text
cleanAgent.description: Paste AI CLI text to preview removal of complete plain box borders. Copy the full result; keep the original.
cleanAgent.hint: Complete plain Unicode boxes only by default. Removes one padding space at each edge; keeps other spacing and pipes. Partial, titled, nested, fenced, and ambiguous-width boxes stay unchanged.
compare.title: Compare lists
compare.rulesText: One item per line. Blank lines are ignored; duplicates keep the first original. Common items use the left original. Results keep source order. Options affect comparison keys only. Case matching folds A–Z only; other Unicode characters stay exact. Combined limit: 1 MiB and {limit} lines.
compare.copyFailed: Copy failed. Your result is preserved; try again.
compare.excluded: Blank lines ignored: left {leftBlank}, right {rightBlank}. Duplicates merged: left {leftDup}, right {rightDup}.
compare.error.bytes: Combined input exceeds 1 MiB. Reduce the input; no truncated result is available.
compare.error.lines: Combined input exceeds {limit} lines. Reduce the input; no truncated result is available.
compare.error.failed: Comparison failed. Edit the input to retry; previous results cannot be copied.
markdownPlain.title: Markdown to Plain Text
markdownPlain.hint: Keeps addresses, task states, code and definitions. HTML and entities stay literal; nothing is loaded or executed. Input ≤128 KiB; full output ≤512 KiB.
markdownPlain.limit: Input, output or nesting exceeds the conversion limit. Reduce the input; no partial result is available.
markdownPlain.timeout: Conversion took too long. Your input is kept; simplify it to retry.
markdownPlain.failed: Could not convert the text. Your input is kept; edit to retry.
